mission.title: pipecd: Plugin architectured piped (pipedv1) supports deployment for applications
mission.description: Plugin architectured piped (pipedv1) supports deployment for applications. Community-requested feature.

steps.title: Check current pipecd deployment
steps.description:
Verify your pipecd version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n pipecd -l app.kubernetes.io/name=pipecd
helm list -n pipecd 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working pipecd installation.

steps.title: Review pipecd configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant pipecd configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n pipecd -l app.kubernetes.io/name=pipecd
kubectl get configmap -n pipecd -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=pipecd
```
**What would you like to be added**:

This issue is for managing the process of adopting plugin architecture to piped. The ideal result is to make all platform providers' logic independent from the piped core logic (the controller package).

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n pipecd -l app.kubernetes.io/name=pipecd
kubectl get events -n pipecd --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "Plugin architectured piped (pipedv1) supports deployment…" is functioning correctly.
